source_description: Resolve the overloaded meaning of 'store': data access (DataStore) and model-artifact storage (ModelStore) become separately named packages, and the scattered model-object loader and cache move into the model-artifact package. Behaviour-preserving move of 41 import statements across 6 modules, plus first test coverage for the model-loading path so the move is verifiable. Runs before model-registry-and-base-refresh, which adds four more model-artifact modules.
